question: Vipul invests a sum of ₹5400 and Vijay invests a sum of ₹9400 at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If, at the end of 5 years, Vijay gets ₹840 more interest than Vipul, then find the rate of interest per annum (in percentage).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The difference in interest is entirely due to the difference in principal amounts.

Principal difference = ₹9400 − ₹5400 = ₹4000

Interest difference (SI) = (ΔP × R × T) ÷ 100

840 = (4000 × R × 5) ÷ 100

840 = 200 × R ⇒ R = 4.2%

**∴ The correct answer is 4.2%.**
